items.title: BharatBenz gets Rs 4,000 crore boost as Daimler India expands in Tamil Nadu
items.summary: Daimler India Commercial Vehicles plans a significant Rs 4,000 crore investment in Tamil Nadu. This expansion will strengthen its BharatBenz brand and create approximately 400 new jobs. The investment aims to enhance product development and manufacturing capabilities for rising domestic demand.

items.summary: Hinduja Group plans a significant Rs 2,500 crore investment across its Tamil Nadu businesses. This includes renewable energy projects and electric mobility solutions. The group will develop over 200 MW of clean energy generation capacity. Electric buses will be operationalised for public transport in the state.

items.title: India's electronics exports surge 11-fold to Rs 4.24 lakh crore, women's workforce nears 30%
items.summary: India's electronics export industry has experienced a remarkable increase, soaring over elevenfold to reach Rs 4.24 lakh crore by FY2025-26. This impressive growth positions India as the second-largest mobile phone manufacturer globally, with Rs 2.59 lakh crore in exports. The sector has generated twelve lakh jobs.

items.title: In pictures: Europe's best solar eclipse since 1999
items.summary: A total solar eclipse crossed Iceland and Spain on Aug. 12, while much of Europe saw a partial eclipse and businesses benefited from demand.

items.title: Sensex climbs 100 points, Nifty 50 ends below 24,400; US-Iran uncertainty keep investors cautious

items.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 13 August: Apar Industries, Hindalco, Ather Energy, Force Motors, CUB among top losers
items.summary: Indian stocks slid further, driven down by weak financial participation and high crude oil prices. The Nifty decreased by 0.34% and Sensex by 0.13%, with key sectors like metals and cement seeing significant losses amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Ukraine attacks Russian grain export terminals in Black Sea, prompting warning about food markets
items.summary: Ukraine has launched a heavy drone assault on warships and major Russian grain export terminals in the Black Sea port city of Novorossiysk.

items.title: Parliamentary panel backs govt steps to strengthen IBC recovery, seeks deeper action on fund diversion
items.summary: A parliamentary panel has backed govt efforts to improve insolvency recovery, seeking urgent action to prevent fund diversion during insolvency proceedings. The committee noted a significant gap between avoidance transaction values and actual recoveries.

items.title: Milky Mist IPO subscribed 42.29 times so far on closing day, QIBs lead demand
items.summary: The ₹1,553-crore IPO has a price band of ₹133-140 per share. The issue comprised a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹1,428 crore and an offer-for-sale of up to ₹125 crore.

items.title: Gaja Capital heads to IPO amid rising investor demand for transparency
items.summary: The alternative asset manager’s stock-market debut comes as limited partners demand greater transparency on governance, succession and decision-making.

items.title: Solar Industries Q1 results: Net profit jumps 92.6% YoY to ₹653 crore, revenue up 70.3%
items.summary: Solar Industries reported Q1 FY27 net profit of ₹653 crore, up 92.6% YoY. Revenue rose 70.3% to ₹3,668 crore. EBITDA increased 82% to ₹1,024 crore, with a margin of 27.7%. The company is optimistic, aiming for FY27 revenue of ₹14,000 crore.

items.title: Technocraft Ventures IPO listing in focus. Here's what GMP signals ahead of debut
items.summary: Technocraft Ventures IPO: The public issue received a strong response from investors, with the IPO being subscribed 38.69 times overall.

items.title: Solar Industries shares jump 8% to fresh lifetime high after Q1 net profit soars 93% YoY to Rs 653 crore
items.summary: Solar Industries shares surged over 8% after the company reported a 93% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 652.55 crore and 70% revenue growth. Strong defence, domestic and international explosives businesses, a Rs 21,350 crore order book and Rs 14,000 crore FY27 revenue guidance boosted investor confidence in growth prospects.

items.title: Anthropic to beat SpaceX? Investors bet on $2 trillion valuation in record IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is heading towards a potential record-breaking IPO, with investors reportedly expecting a valuation of more than $2 trillion as the AI startup’s revenue continues to surge. The Claude maker’s rapid growth, strong demand for AI tools and lofty revenue projections are fuelling bullish expectations despite intensifying competition, regulatory pressure and other challenges.

items.title: India merchandise exports hit record $44.24 billion for July, trade deficit widens
items.summary: For the April-July period, merchandise exports rose 17% to $173.78 billion from a year earlier.

items.title: Jubilant FoodWorks profit rises as Domino's sales growth picks up
items.summary: Jubilant FoodWorks posted a higher first-quarter profit on Thursday. This increase was aided by steady growth at Domino's India. The company also saw continued store expansion during the period. Profit rose about six percent year-on-year for the quarter. This marks a significant financial performance for the business.

items.title: Air India makes psychoactive substance testing mandatory for pilots after Phuket incident
items.summary: Air India now mandates psychoactive substance testing for all pilots. This new internal measure enhances safety protocols beyond DGCA requirements. Previously, the airline followed DGCA rules for random testing of personnel. The Phuket incident prompted Air India to tighten its internal safety checks.

items.title: Fourth rail line approved through strategic 'Chicken's Neck' corridor: Official
items.summary: A fourth railway line has been approved for the strategically important Chicken's Neck corridor. This crucial link connects the Northeast with the rest of India. Infrastructure initiatives include a nearly 29-km double-line underground project near Bagdogra. New local train services are planned from Jogbani, Radhikapur and Balurghat soon.

items.title: World’s largest jeweler bets on platinum despite falling silver prices, CEO tells CNBC
items.summary: Pandora is moving ahead with platinum-plated jewelry as it seeks to reduce its exposure to volatile silver prices despite the metal's recent decline.

items.title: Shipping giants warn ports and trucks could hold up deliveries and push up prices
items.summary: Global shipping demand remains strong despite geopolitical turmoil, but port and trucking bottlenecks are increasing congestion and putting upward pressure on freight rates.

items.title: Ashish Kacholia-owned Credent Connect N Care IPO opens today. GMP, subscription status, other details in 10 points
items.summary: Credent Connect N Care IPO opens today with plans to raise ₹94 crore. The company excels in healthcare logistics, servicing over 2,500 labs across India. It aims to become the first listed dedicated healthcare logistics platform.

items.title: Centre asks Air India to ‘take responsibility’ after Phuket-Delhi flight scare; orders tighter dope checks: Report
items.summary: The government has warned Air India to “take responsibility” for safety after the August 4 Phuket-Delhi flight scare and ordered DGCA to tighten aviation personnel’s drug-testing rules. The regulator has been asked to expand mandatory testing and impose tougher penalties for genuine drug violations while allowing more chances in medicine-related positive tests.

items.title: Lenskart shares hit record high after Q1 profit jumps nearly four-fold; Motilal Oswal lifts target price
items.summary: Lenskart Solutions' shares rose 7% to an all-time high of ₹627 after posting a net profit of ₹228 crore for Q1 FY27, a 273% increase. Revenue grew 43.3% YoY to ₹2,714.18 crore, driven by strong domestic and international demand for eyewear.

items.summary: Heavyweight memory chipmakers Samsung Electronics Co and SK Hynix Inc drive advance

items.title: Bitcoin near $63K, Ethereum below $1,900 as softer US inflation fails to ease crypto market pressure
items.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum remained under pressure despite softer US inflation data, with analysts pointing to key support and resistance levels as markets await US PPI data for the next directional cue. Altcoins showed mixed moves, while subdued ETF flows and cautious investor sentiment continued to weigh on the broader crypto market.

items.title: JioStar banks on Premier League fandom with ‘Humara Long Distance Love’ campaign
items.summary: JioStar launches a new campaign celebrating Indian Premier League football fans. The campaign features Tiger Shroff and cricketers Sanju Samson and Riyan Parag. It highlights the passion and loyalty of fans supporting their favorite clubs. The 2026/27 Premier League season begins August 22 and runs until May 30.

items.title: Black Box Q1 net profit up 18% to Rs 56 crore
items.summary: Black Box has announced a remarkable eighteen percent rise in profits for the June quarter, attributed to a solid order book and growth in its Brazilian sector. Revenue from operations surged to Rs 8,986 crore, a significant eighty-three percent increase, achieving a record quarterly revenue of Rs 1,719 crore. Plans are underway for Black Box to recruit three thousand new professionals predominantly in the US by the year 2030.

items.title: An inside look at SK Hynix $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea
items.summary: SK Hynix, the leading maker of high-bandwidth memory, is pouring $720 billion into memory factories to meet AI demand. We got an exclusive first look.

items.title: IndiQube Spaces Q1 revenue jumps 37% to record Rs 428 crore
items.summary: IndiQube Spaces reported record Q1FY27 revenue of ₹428 crore, up 37% year-on-year. EBITDA rose 34%, while PAT surged 91% to ₹35 crore. Area under management and seat capacity expanded, alongside stronger occupancy and rapidly growing value-added services.

items.title: India’s July trade deficit widens to $31.98 bn from $30.43 bn in June
items.summary: India’s merchandise trade deficit widened to $31.98 billion in July from $30.43 billion in June, exceeding economists’ estimate of $30.20 billion, according to a Reuters poll. Merchandise exports rose to $44.24 billion from $40.41 billion in June, but imports increased more sharply to $76.22 billion from $70.84 billion.

items.title: GIC Q1 results: Standalone profit jumps 10% YoY to ₹1,922 crore
items.summary: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC), on Thursday, 13 August, reported its profit after tax increased by 9.69% to ₹1,922.04 crore for the quarter ended June 2026 as compared to profit of ₹1,752.23 crore for the quarter ended June 2025.

items.title: Shriram Properties Q1 profit down 46% to Rs 11 cr
items.summary: Shriram Properties faced a significant profit decrease of forty-six percent in the June quarter, largely affected by rising operational expenses and taxes. Nevertheless, the company recorded a slight increase in total income to Rs 271.04 crore and experienced a ten percent rise in sales bookings to Rs 484 crore. Their project pipeline remains strong, extending through various cities in India.

items.title: Upcoming IPO: Muthoot Fincorp files DRHP with SEBI to raise ₹3,000 crore through the IPO route
items.summary: According to the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) filed on Wednesday, the proposed IPO will comprise entirely of a fresh issue of equity shares.

items.summary: Navi Ltd. is preparing for an Indian IPO targeting up to $315 million, with JM Financial, Kotak Mahindra Capital, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan advising. The fintech firm seeks a valuation of up to $2 billion and plans to file by December. The offering is expected to comprise only a primary share sale.

items.summary: Globally, gold futures decline by 0.31% to $4,394.57 per ounce in New York

items.summary: European shares edged higher as easing oil prices offered some relief, though stalled US-Iran peace efforts and Strait of Hormuz disruptions capped gains. The STOXX 600 rose 0.2%, while the FTSE 100 slipped 0.3% despite stronger-than-expected UK economic growth.

items.title: India’s gem and jewellery exports rise 0.38% to $2.35 billion in July
items.summary: India’s gem and jewellery exports remained nearly flat in July 2026, rising 0.38% year-on-year in dollar terms to $2.35 billion, while rupee-denominated exports increased 11.68% to Rs 22,511.64 crore, according to GJEPC data. Gold jewellery drove growth, with exports rising 8.73%, while studded gold jewellery jumped 21.36%.

items.title: Penny stock under ₹1 hits 5% upper circuit after Q1 results despite muted trends on Dalal Street
items.summary: GACM Technologies share price has jumped 56% over the last month despite stock market volatility. The stock hit a 52-week low of ₹0.40 on 30 March this year after hitting a 52-week high of ₹0.94 on 24 September last year.

items.title: ‘Hormuz remains blocked’: Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks to near 3-month lows
items.summary: The Persian Strait Gulf Authority said "the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are accepted."

items.title: Convenience gains festive ground as quick commerce set to outpace e-commerce
items.summary: The festival months will also serve as a test for platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart, for whom micro-festivals have emerged as key periods for sales spikes and bigger baskets.

items.title: Global Market | Shein plans Hong Kong stock market debut on August 28: Reports
items.summary: Shein is reportedly planning a Hong Kong IPO on August 28, reviving its long-awaited public listing plans after exploring New York and London. The Singapore-based fast-fashion retailer may target a $30–40 billion valuation, well below its 2022 peak, amid slower growth, higher costs and financial pressure following US trade-policy changes.

items.title: China to keep imposing anti-dumping duties on Indian single-mode optical fibre imports
items.summary: China will continue anti-dumping duties on Indian optical fibre for five years. This decision follows a review which concluded dumping could harm China's industry. Existing tax rates will remain unchanged for various Indian exporters. Duties were first imposed in August 2014 and extended previously. The measures will remain in effect starting this Friday.

items.title: FMCG stock shows resilience against Dalal Street bears
items.summary: The FMCG stock opened at ₹92.85 apiece today, as compared to previous close ₹91.38 on Wednesday.

items.title: Nuclear power plants are being shut down as Europe’s drought becomes an energy crisis
items.summary: Heat and drought are curbing nuclear output across Europe, with Romania starting the process of disconnecting its sole working reactor from the power grid.

items.title: Lenskart gets leg-up from international biz even as India expansion continues
items.summary: Lenskart’s overseas business delivered a sharp margin boost in Q1, while India continued its store expansion. Sustaining profitability of new stores will be a key monitorable.

items.title: Q1 earnings show resilience as demand, cost headwinds prove less severe than expected: ICRA
items.summary: ICRA said India Inc’s Q1 FY27 earnings began on a stronger-than-expected note, with revenue growth accelerating to 22%. Despite margin pressure from higher commodity costs and weakness in oil refining and IT services, consumption-led sectors remained resilient. Healthy corporate balance sheets, rising capex and improving credit metrics offer support.

items.title: Thyrocare shares crack 8% as promoter Docon Technologies sells 10% stake
items.summary: Thyrocare Technologies shares fell after promoter Docon Technologies sold around 1.58 crore shares, cutting its stake from 60.92% to 51.02%. Docon remains the diagnostics company’s promoter and holding company.

items.title: Newly-listed metal stock Rajputana Stainless surges 10%, hits record high after strong Q1 results
items.summary: Rajputana Stainless reported 32.4% year-on-year growth in its revenue from operations to ₹306.54 crore for Q1 FY27. Profit after tax rose 80.5% to ₹20.20 crore from ₹11.19 crore in Q1FY26.

items.title: Afcons’ turnaround story stumbles on execution roadblocks
items.summary: Payment delays and labour shortages continue to squeeze margins and delay revenue conversion, overshadowing a record ₹43,300-crore order book and causing the stock to fall 30% this year.

items.title: Munjal Auto Industries shares soar 15%, hit 52-week high after Q1 results. What moved the stock?
items.summary: Munjal Auto Industries reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance, with consolidated revenue rising sharply and the company turning profitable from a year-ago loss. Both its auto components and composite products segments recorded healthy growth, while a mark-to-market gain on mutual fund investments also supported other income.

items.title: ITA backs 11 Indian projects; to advance over $18 bn in clean industry investment
items.summary: Eleven Indian clean industrial projects will receive tailored support from the Industrial Transition Accelerator. These initiatives represent over eighteen billion dollars in potential investment and significant carbon abatement. Companies like Jindal Steel and JSW Steel are developing carbon capture technologies. ACME Group and ReNew are advancing green ammonia and methanol production facilities. Circular Urban Energy will produce sustainable aviation fuel from waste materials.

items.title: Sugar stocks Balrampur Chini, Dhampur Sugar, Dalmia Bharat Sugar, others rally up to 7%. Here’s why
items.summary: Sugar stocks rose sharply on Thursday as domestic sugar prices climbed 8-10% in a month to a seven-year high. Rising global sugar prices, worsening supply prospects in Brazil, higher ethanol blending, weather risks and lower output estimates in Thailand and India are tightening global supplies and supporting sugar prices.

items.title: Tata Trusts starts process to find successor for Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran
items.summary: The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust passes a resolution to initiate the setting up of a selection committee for the purpose of recommending a person for appointment as the new chairman.

items.title: UBS upgrades MCX to Buy with Rs 3,800 target price: Can it boost the stock?
items.summary: UBS upgraded MCX to Buy from Neutral and raised its target price to Rs 3,800, citing attractive valuations, resilient trading volumes and positive regulatory developments. The brokerage also raised its FY27-FY29 EPS estimates by 4%-9%, while expecting strong commodity volatility and operating leverage to support earnings growth.

items.title: Stocks to buy: Nagaraj Shetti recommends Bank of Maharashtra, Hindustan Copper shares to buy in the short-term
items.summary: The Indian stock market remained under strain, with Nifty 50 down 0.28% and BSE Sensex stable. Elevated crude oil prices and increasing retail inflation impacted investor sentiment, while Reliance Industries faced a decline due to MSCI index adjustments amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Motilal Oswal commits Rs 1,500 crore to Inox Clean in hybrid private credit deal
items.summary: Motilal Oswal Group has committed Rs 1,500 crore to Inox Clean Energy Ltd through compulsorily convertible debentures to fund acquisitions and growth. The initial Rs 1,000 crore has been deployed, with the remaining Rs 500 crore expected soon. This hybrid capital investment aims for an equity conversion upon Inox Clean's potential IPO within 12-24 months, offering downside protection and equity upside.

items.title: India bonds consolidate as traders seek fresh cues
items.summary: Indian government bonds showed minor fluctuations as market participants remained cautious, looking for new cues. Meanwhile, oil prices settled amidst ongoing concerns over a possible peace deal between the U.S. and Iran. Investors seemed unfazed by recent inflation statistics from both the domestic scene and the U.S., which reinforced the view that interest rate adjustments from either central bank are unlikely soon. items.title: KRN Heat Exchanger shares hit 5% upper circuit as Q1 net profit more than doubles
items.summary: Shares of KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration hit a upper circuit on Thursday, following a strong Q1 FY27 earnings performance. The rally was driven by robust demand across both domestic and international markets.

items.title: Euro zone bonds little changed as oil prices steady
items.summary: Euro zone bond yields showed little movement on Thursday, coinciding with steady oil prices. Recent U.S. inflation data has lessened the market's anticipation of a Federal Reserve rate increase in the upcoming month. With energy dialogues taking place and the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, investors are on alert. Rising oil prices could lead to continued interest rate hikes by the ECB.

items.title: Global Market: Japan wholesale inflation stays elevated, bolstering September rate hike bets
items.summary: Japan’s wholesale inflation stayed elevated in July, with producer prices rising 7.2% year-on-year, reinforcing expectations of a September Bank of Japan rate hike. Broad-based cost pressures, higher import prices and yen weakness are raising inflation risks, while stronger metal and raw-material costs could further pressure consumer prices and accelerate monetary tightening.
